Technology Value Chain: Market Concentration in India vs China

Electronics Industry

Stage 1 – Basic Products (Chargers, USB cables, phone cases) — India: 20% | China: 10%
Stage 2 – Components (PCBs, batteries, connectors) — India: 60% | China: 20%

India lost the GAME at STAGE 2 : most likely due to "Weak manufacturing and MSME ecosystem" - destroyed by GST, Crony capitalism and economics NOT due to incapabilities.

NOTE : Stage 1 and Stage 2 is Bahujan dominated 

Stage 3 – Smart Devices (Earbuds, routers, CCTV, IoT devices) — India: 80% | China: 40%
Stage 4 – Industrial Electronics (EV electronics, medical devices, automation) — India: 75–85% | China: 50%
Stage 5 – Advanced Hardware (Motherboards, camera modules, RF modules) — India: 85–95% | China: 60%
Stage 6 – Semiconductor Design (CPU, GPU, AI chips, modem chips) — India: 95% | China: 70–85%
Stage 7 – Semiconductor Manufacturing (Wafer fabrication, chip packaging, display fabs) — India: 95%+ | China: 80%
Stage 8 – Complete Products (Smartphones, laptops, telecom equipment) — India: 95% | China: 75%

Software Industry

Stage 1 – IT Services (Software development, testing, maintenance) — India: 70% | China: 30%

India didn't lost at stage 1 but for marginalized section of society the GAME is OVER at stage 1 itself due to Narayana Murthy and BRO's IT colonialism.

Stage 2 – Business Software (ERP, CRM, HRMS, accounting software) — India: 80% | China: 40%

India lost the GAME at STAGE 2 as it was already at the verge of collapse

Stage 3 – Developer Tools (Databases, IDEs, DevOps, cybersecurity) — India: 90% | China: 60%
Stage 4 – Embedded Software (Firmware, IoT, automotive software) — India: 70% | China: 60%
Stage 5 – Core Platforms (Operating systems, browsers, databases) — India: 95% | China: 70%
Stage 6 – Cloud & AI (Cloud platforms, AI models, digital infrastructure) — India: 90% | China: 70%
Stage 7 – Global Software Products (Enterprise software, SaaS, productivity software) — India: 90% | China: 70%
Stage 8 – Digital Ecosystem (OS + Cloud + AI + App Store + Digital Platforms) — India: 95% | China: 90%

How exactly can we stop brain drain or similar if we cutoff the supply at the stage 1 and stage 2 itself ??
